notes.title: From the mind of YOKO TARO: The Voice of Cards Trilogy is on sale now!
notes.notes:
The Voice of Cards series are quirky RPGs where the whole world is depicted through the medium of cards.

Voice of Cards Trilogy brings together all three games from the series; “The Isle Dragon Roars”, “The Forsaken Maiden” and “The Beasts of Burden” in one extra-value set.

In the Voice of Cards games you will experience the atmosphere of playing a tabletop RPG, listening to narration by the game master along the way, and with the outcomes of events and battles occasionally resting on the fall of the dice.
Each of the games in the trilogy is based in the same setting, but their respective stories are completely unconnected, so you are free to start from whichever one you please.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30738/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41258953/4f874a7503ea925a404d6d3bd229d4f66e2ebc37.png[/img][/url]

Bringing you a new, yet nostalgic gaming experience from YOKO Taro (Creative director) , Okabe Keiichi (Music director) and Fujisaka Kimihiko (Character designer).

A “Voice of Cards Trilogy + DLC set” is also available, containing DLC that lets you change the designs of in-game items such as card backs and playing pieces to a theme based on YOKO Taro's other works, as well as DLC to change the BGM and the illustrations to a pixel art style.

*The various content included in “Voice of Cards Trilogy” and “Voice of Cards Trilogy + DLC set” are identical to the same items sold separately. Please take care to avoid making duplicate purchases.
*Please be aware that services requiring an internet connection may be closed down after a set time has passed from the game’s release.

notes.title: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden is availble now!
notes.notes:
Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden is available now!

YOKO TARO, Keiichi Okabe and Kimihiko Fujisaka present the story of a girl who swears revenge on monsters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42894513/802551d20d8d0a7c9b1e105cbe5d2445de246962.png[/img]

DLC is also available for purchase that can change the design of in-game components such as cards and avatars to be styled after other YOKO TARO titles.

Those who purchase the game by 3 October 2022 16:00 (UTC) will receive early purchase bonus DLC items!

What is “Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden”?
In a world where “monsters” roam the land.
Humans and monsters were in constant conflict.

A girl who lost what is precious to her in a monster attack.
A boy who leads her by the hand.

Together, they discover the woreld and find something that is truly irreplaceable...

notes.title: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden is available for pre-purchase now!
notes.notes:
The third entry in the unique Voice of Cards series of RPGs, where everything is depicted through the medium of cards, is available to pre-purchase now!  Brought to you by the creative minds of YOKO TARO, Okabe Keiichi and Fujisaka Kimihiko.

Alongside the standalone edition, the "Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden + DLC set" is also available for pre-order. This set contains the main game plus DLC that allows you to change the designs of the card backings and playing pieces used in-game to designs inspired by other YOKO TARO titles, and changes the appearance of all the characters to a pixel art style.

Customers who purchase the game before 16:00 on Monday 03/10/2022 (UTC) will also receive special early purchase bonus DLC.

Why not take this opportunity to check out the amazing Voice of Cards series?!
